---
name: Feature request / improvement idea
about: Suggest something this blueprint should add, change, or document
labels: enhancement
---

## The need

What problem are you trying to solve? Who has it?

## Proposal

What you'd like this blueprint to add, change, or document. Concrete is
better than abstract.

## Alternatives you considered

Why not just do X instead?

## Who would maintain it?

Honest answer matters. The blueprint stays small on purpose — please tell us
whether you'd be willing to contribute the change yourself or whether you
need the maintainer to take it on.
